#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import sys


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Count lines, words, and characters in a text file.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("file", nargs="?", default="-", help="File to read (default: stdin)")
    group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    group.add_argument("-l", action="store_true", dest="lines", help="Count lines")
    group.add_argument("-w", action="store_true", dest="words", help="Count words")
    group.add_argument("-c", action="store_true", dest="chars", help="Count characters")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    # If no flags are set, show all three
    if not any([args.lines, args.words, args.chars]):
        args.lines = True
        args.words = True
        args.chars = True

    # Read input
    if args.file == "-":
        raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    else:
        with open(args.file, "rb") as f:
            raw = f.read()

    # Characters = bytes of the file as read
    char_count = len(raw)

    # Decode for line/word counting
    text = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    # Lines: count newline characters; a final line without trailing newline still counts
    if text:
        line_count = text.count("\n")
        if not text.endswith("\n"):
            line_count += 1
    else:
        line_count = 0

    # Words: split on whitespace
    word_count = len(text.split())

    results = []
    if args.lines:
        results.append(str(line_count))
    if args.words:
        results.append(str(word_count))
    if args.chars:
        results.append(str(char_count))

    print(" ".join(results))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
